notes.title: 1 DAY BEFORE THE GAME RELEASE!
notes.notes:
Dear [i]Vincent[/i], a real horror awaits you! [b]Tomorrow, February 27[/b], our new game [b]"Vincent's Horror Story" is released[/b]. Immerse yourself in the world of mystical phenomena and struggle for survival. Are you ready to emerge victorious from this fight?
In the game [b]"Vincent's Horror Story"[/b] you will find not only scary monsters, but also real tests for your mind. Discover all the secrets that Vincent's mind hides and try to survive this nightmare. Are you ready for the deadly challenge? [b]Then we are waiting for you in the game![/b]ːsteamthisː
